I'm sure you're all tired. There's not much we can\noffer in this kind of situation, but please get\nsome rest in the village.

Nothing. Let's go back for now!
Explore Boma Moja a little longer!

Maybe those in the cockpit know something.\nLet's go ask them!

I told you this place is being moved safely with\na propulsion system, if there's no cockpit,\nhow do we know where it's heading to?
